gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-nag-m: Noto Sans Nag Mundari reads half unwrapped, its c and s curling open, lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Capture It stands over it with a towering, urban x-height and a rounded-nib look, nearly sealed letters against that looser sans.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-nandi: Capture It has a towering x-height and letters nearly sealed shut, with no thick-thin flicker in the lines. Noto Sans Nandinagari loosens everything below it, with short ascenders and generous openings.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-newa: Tight, tall and urban, Capture It keeps its letters almost closed, with no stroke contrast to catch the eye. And Noto Sans Newa opens right up beneath it, the lowercase e showing a clear mouth and tall bowls.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Chunky, tall and nearly sealed, Capture It hits hard with its towering x-height and commanding urban feel. Noto Sans Nushu answers tall too, but holds its terminals far out.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham reads bold for a light face, because its lowercase bodies are so tall and the e gaps are wide. But Capture It overhead traces a constant-width outline you could follow with a finger, nearly sealed where the body stays open.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-ol-ch: Noto Sans Ol Chiki sets its words as solid blocks rather than skylines, with curve tails held well back from the body. And Capture It, towering and nearly shut, gives that plain sans a heavy, urban header to sit under.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-old-h: Capture It draws its towering, nearly sealed letters with a constant-width pen line and no contrast at all. Noto Sans Old Hungarian stays open even at tiny sizes, so try it small.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-old-i: Capture It towers, with a nearly closed look and no thick-thin flicker. Its strength is the gap: Noto Sans Old Italic sits tight between x-height and caps, curve endings kept well apart, so the sealed heading and the open sans pull in opposite directions.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-old-n: Capture It has a towering x-height and a t whose crossbar and stem share one width, all tightly closed. And Noto Sans Old North Arabian answers with a dense, tall lowercase band, terminals pointing outward like tongs.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-noto-sans-old-p: Capture It draws its rounds and stems in one weight, towering and nearly sealed, with an urban, commanding stance. Noto Sans Old Permic flows on below with rounded forms open to the side, lowercase almost matching its capitals.
